meta.title: GitHub manager
meta.description: Full-permission GitHub management: browser OAuth with 13 scopes, credentials and tokens AES-256-GCM encrypted on this machine only, no OAuth App credentials shipped. 58 gh_* tools covering repository create/delete/update, code read-write-delete, branches and tags, gh_push publishing a local directory through the Git Data API (changed files only, credentials blocked), gh_download for a repo snapshot or single file, CI dispatch plus runs, job steps, logs, artifact download and cancel, SSH/GPG/deploy keys and Actions secrets, pull request create/detail/merge, issues and comments, releases, collaborators, webhooks, gists, compare, and gh_api for any endpoint. Ships skills/github-manager to guide the agent across them. No gh CLI and no separate PAT.
